title: Redis Streams connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Redis Streams instance's settings (CN2 Task 14): the source reads streams through a consumer group with XREADGROUP and acknowledges with XACK only after the Fabric has the batch; the sink XADDs each event in CloudEvents binary mode. Served by loams-connector-kv against Redis and Valkey. `password` is the name of a secret in the namespace's secret store (D189).

url.description: redis://host[:port][/db] or rediss://… for TLS. Credentials in the URL are refused.

password.description: The name of the secret holding the ACL password.

stream.description: The stream key the source reads (one split), and the sink XADDs to.

streams.description: More stream keys for the source, one split each.

consumer_group.description: The consumer group; loams-<instance> when omitted.

consumer_name.description: The consumer name; the instance name when omitted.

start_id.description: Where a new consumer group starts: 0 (the whole stream) or $ (new entries only).

ack_mode.description: after-ack: XACK after the Fabric acknowledges (at least once). on-read: XREADGROUP NOACK (at most once).

block_ms.description: How long XREADGROUP blocks for new entries.

pending_idle_ms.description: Claim (XAUTOCLAIM) entries other consumers left pending this long, so a killed consumer's entries are not stranded.
